description_excerpt: Job Description This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement. We are looking for an Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer (2-3 Years of Experience) to join our automotive engineering team. The candidate will be involved in the development of diagnostic software solutions for modern vehicles, working with standard automotive diagnostic protocols and performing validation directly on test vehicles.
